::: notes
Mastery of [Elementary Algebra](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elementary_algebra) 
(a.k.a. "College Algebra")  is a prerequisite for calculus, 
which is in turn a prerequisite for most statistics and data science courses.
Nevertheless, each year,
some students are still uncomfortable
with algebraic manipulations of mathematical formulas.
Therefore, I include this section as a quick reference.
:::
